environment.description: Same NestJS service deployed on ECS Fargate. JWT_SIGNING_SECRET is injected via a sidecar agent (CyberArk Conjur follower) that performs credential rotation every 60 seconds with zero-grace-period invalidation of prior secret material. The Conjur policy (policy id: billing-svc/jwt-signer) enforces that each secret version is cryptographically bound to the requesting pod identity via SPIFFE SVID, and the rotation callback triggers an in-memory hot-swap of the signing key in the application process via a Unix domain socket notification. Additionally, an Envoy sidecar with an ext_authz filter calls a PDP (Cedar policy engine) that evaluates the policy: `permit(principal, action == Action::"read", resource) when { principal.sub == resource.owner };` — meaning the Cedar PDP rejects any request where the JWT subject does not match the resource owner extracted from the URL path segment.

config.secret_rotation: CyberArk Conjur, 60s TTL, zero-grace invalidation, SPIFFE-bound
config.network: Envoy sidecar with ext_authz gRPC filter -> Cedar PDP
config.cedar_policy: permit(principal, action == Action::read, resource) when { principal.sub == resource.owner }
config.envoy_ext_authz: gRPC call to cedar-pdp.internal:8081, fail-closed, timeout 50ms
